en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large brick building with decorative striping, steep gabled roofs, and turrets in a Neo-Gothic/Neo-Renaissance style. In front are small gardens and a drive where carriages or early vehicles are visible. At the bottom of the image the word 'Nijmegen' appears on the left and 'Station.' on the right, indicating it is the railway station of Nijmegen. Publisher information is printed along the lower margin.
